Thanks again for the patience and support![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/1d767de6726e7a617b7c68b76154f13781d1a1d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dino Run Multiplayer Update / Open-Sourcing The Game
notes.notes:
[b]We're open-sourcing Dino Run DX.[/b]

As some of our most dedicated players have discovered, Dino Run DX multiplayer no longer works. The wonderful folks at Xgen Studios, who basically let multiplayer live rent-free for years, had to recently sunset all of their legacy games (like Stick Arena) and the servers that run them. And as you can imagine, Dino Run used those servers.  

They DID send us the source code to the server itself, so maybe we can get it up and running again on our end. However, we haven't been able to compile the actual game for years now, since it's legacy flash and that no longer works on any computer that we own.

So...

1) We've uploaded the Dino Run DX source code to the [i]legacy-dinorun[/i] channel on our discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/JM2MMUf]https://discord.com/invite/JM2MMUf[/url]. It's a pinned post. Anyone that wants to try and compile the game (Using Flash Builder 4.7) is welcome to.  Let us know if you can get it working!

UPDATE: The source also exists on GIT now: https://github.com/pixeljam/DinoRunDX

2) If someone can recompile DX, we'll see if we can get the server up and running on our end with the source that Xgen sent us.

3) We're very close to having a very small multiplayer experience playable for Dino Run 2!  More on that in the coming months.

Thanks for the many lovely memories racing dinos.   Time to pour one out...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/1fabb2e735129fa613377fc8e86e10c63b99d044.jpg[/img]

Thanks for the support, and we hope you love the new update!

notes.title: Schedule of Upcoming Updates and Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello Runners,

Thanks to everyone for a successful launch!  We hope you're enjoying the game and that you've saved a few dinos in the process.

As you may or may not know, DX is a work in progress... we'll be adding content and features over the coming months to make your experience even better.

[b]Here is what's coming up relatively soon:[/b]
- Full Controller Support, so you can navigate every aspect of the game without touching your filthy keyboard.
- Trading Cards
- Squashing a whole bunch of barely perceptible graphics glitches (some are a bit glaring though)
- Optimizing the game to run smoother (a lot of the code was written many years ago and could use a tune up)

[b]Here is what's planned a bit further out:[/b]
- Level Sharing Seed Codes (you get a little code to share with friends so they can play the exact same level as you)
- Free Run Mode for Single and Multiplayer (no doom wall, and you can chat / emote / role-play in the actual race).  This one should be a blast.

All of the things listed above ARE GOING TO HAPPEN, without doubt.   Beyond those we hope to add new hats, colors, levels, terrains, modes of play, etc.  Those things depend on multiple factors, namely Steam sales and crowdfunding outcomes.  More on the crowdfunding here: http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun

That's all for now.  Thanks for reading, playing and surviving!

-The Pixeljam Team
